svg.text: 1. CAP SHARES THE SHELL PROFILE: 76.8 × 11.6, R12.4 CORNERS, LIP 1.2 × 2.0.
2. SOCKET = TONGUE + 0.2 PER SIDE, 6 DEEP. PART A DETENT BUMPS SNAP INTO Ø2.2 HOLES.
3. CAMERA NOTCH IS OPEN TO THE LOWER EDGE SO THE CAP NEVER RIDES OVER THE 1.5 mm CAMERA BUMP.
4. BACK STANDS 0.5 PROUD OF THE CAMERA BUMP; LIP STANDS 1.6 ABOVE THE SCREEN.
5. PRINT BACK-DOWN, NO SUPPORTS. UNTOLERANCED DIMENSIONS ±0.2.

g.text: THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · ALL DIMENSIONS IN mm
